steps.action:
# Open the "Insert" menu in LibreOffice Writer's menubar
pyautogui.click(x=200, y=50, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Insert" menu in the top menubar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=148, y=54, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Insert" menu label on the top menubar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=118, y=53, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Insert" menu in the menubar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=165, y=52, duration=0.3)

# Click the "Insert" menubar item (center of its label) to open its dropdown menu
pyautogui.click(x=175, y=52, duration=0.3)

# Open the "Insert" menu using its keyboard shortcut (Alt+I)
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'i')

# Click "Header and Footer" option (near bottom of open Insert menu) to show its submenu
pyautogui.click(x=210, y=485, duration=0.3)

# Click the "Close" button on the bottom-right of the open Bookmark dialog to dismiss it
pyautogui.click(x=865, y=528, duration=0.3)

# Dismiss the unexpected "Bookmark" dialog by pressing Escape
pyautogui.press('esc')

# Open the "Insert" menu using its keyboard shortcut
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'i')

# Click the "Header and Footer" option (third from bottom of the current Insert menu) to open its submenu
pyautogui.click(x=215, y=515, duration=0.3)

# Close the unexpected "Fields" dialog with Escape so we can proceed
pyautogui.press('esc')

# Open the "Insert" menu dropdown to access footer options
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'i')

# Click the "Header and Footer" entry (one row below "Field") in the open Insert menu to open its submenu
pyautogui.click(x=225, y=535, duration=0.3)

# Close the open "Special Characters" dialog with Escape
pyautogui.press('esc')
